finding_key_mismatch_bug.description: normalizeApprovalBlockers()'s supplementary policyRequiredKeys pass (leaseReviewFieldNormalizer.js:794-806) checks byKey.get(key) using legacy REQUIRED_FIELD_KEYS names (premises_address, premises_use, lease_term) directly against standardFields, which is keyed by LEASE_FIELD_CONTRACT's newer canonical names (property_address, permitted_use, lease_term_months). It never applies the alias table readFieldValue() already uses (leaseReviewSchema.js:210-211), so these three keys are structurally always-missing regardless of whether the aliased field has a real value.
finding_key_mismatch_bug.proof: this document's property_address = '224 S Peters Road Knoxville, TN 37923', status needs_review (not missing), evidenceVerified true, yet approvalBlockers.missingFields still lists premises_address as missing
finding_key_mismatch_bug.reason_not_fixed: Phase 45 is a testing/verification phase only - no source changes planned or made
finding_key_mismatch_bug.never_surfaced_before: the assignment profile's requiredFieldKeys list does not include these three legacy names, so this gap was invisible until tested against a base-lease document
finding_key_mismatch_bug.recommended_fix: alias policyRequiredKeys through the same alias table readFieldValue() uses, or unify both key schemes to one canonical set; verify against both the assignment document (must remain unchanged) and this base-lease document (premises_address should stop appearing once property_address is populated)

phase46_base_lease_alias_fix.root_cause: normalizeApprovalBlockers()'s supplementary policyRequiredKeys pass and buildReadinessSummary()'s missingRequired computation (both in leaseReviewFieldNormalizer.js) checked required field keys (legacy names: premises_address, premises_use, lease_term) directly against standardFields (keyed by LEASE_FIELD_CONTRACT's newer canonical names: property_address, permitted_use, lease_term_months) with no alias resolution, unlike readFieldValue/readFieldEvidence which already resolve aliases via getFieldAliases().
